lines.text: The LORD will bring disaster on this place because the people abandoned Him and built high places to burn children to Baal.
The LORD says this place will be called the Valley of Slaughter, and passersby will be appalled and scoff.
The LORD tells Jeremiah to shatter the jar before the men with him, and says they will bury the dead in Shiloh.
Jeremiah stands in the Benjamin Gate and proclaims that the LORD will bring on Jerusalem and its villages every disaster pronounced.
